method: CPU buildTile cooked geometry audit; emitted terrain triangles and actual derived platform/road top meshes, not initialized support-failure counters

criteria.coverage: All generated vertex/index buffers, actual baked materials and listed representative dynamic generators
Actual same-level asphalt/footway triangles at finite path/width samples; raw path-height warnings are diagnostic only
Both running paths at source segment midpoints outside bores; actual same-level baked canted-bed tops matched within100mm, with actual neighbor soil for cross-owner points.
Actual transformed procedural tree root anchors against emitted terrain triangles

Rendered body/plinth bounds versus whole-footprint finite samples, using actual neighbor terrain for cross-owner points. Missing real-world tiles or emitted soil hits fail; omitted calibration neighbors remain uncertified.
Emitted top triangles, declared support point, actual levelling-plinth bounds where used
Both physical paths and travel directions at 1m intervals; 1.55m half-width with10mm numerical allowance, not a complete stock swept-volume test
Repeated boundary vertices plus all union endpoints/midpoints on built neighbor edges
Every emitted buildTile placement plus procedural tree root in the persisted inventory
All previously failing boundary buildings must remain rendered; every other baseline omission is disclosed. Actual uncovered-support rejection counters are also checked.
Actual baked running rail-head top cross-sections at source segment midpoints; source switch spans excluded for dedicated trackwork checks; no survey certificate

materialAudit.scope: Actual Batch.add materials and representative dynamic train/vehicle/signal/crossing/AWS/TPWS/person generator meshes; rendering buffers and UI text excluded

renderedInnerFaceGauge.scope: Actual baked running rail-head top cross-sections at source segment midpoints; source switch spans excluded for dedicated trackwork checks; no survey certificate

buildingRetention.note: Every omission is disclosed. Previously failing regression assets must remain present; other changed retention requires review and cannot be called a full source-instance completeness pass.

sourceInstanceFidelity.scope: Detailed source/site fidelity is separate from physically consistent rendered geometry and regression retention.
